name: CDC Open Data (Socrata)
agency: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

endpoints.description: Query a CDC dataset (SoQL) by its 4x4 dataset identifier

limits.notes: Works without a token but throttled and shared-pool; an app token raises limits substantially. Default $limit=1000 rows per request.

llmDocs.summary: CDC public health datasets via the Socrata Open Data API: mortality, chronic disease, vaccination, surveillance (e.g. flu, COVID), BRFSS. Each dataset has a unique 4x4 ID and SoQL query support.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Find the dataset's 4x4 id (e.g. 9mfq-cb36) from data.cdc.gov, then GET /resource/{id}.json with SoQL params: $select, $where, $order, $limit, $offset, or simple column=value filters. Send X-App-Token header to avoid throttling.

exampleQueries.intent: Filter a dataset by state and date

gotchas: You must know each dataset's 4x4 id; there is no single unified schema — every dataset differs.
Default row cap is 1000; use $limit and $offset to page.
SoQL $where uses single-quoted ISO dates and floating-point timestamps; column names are the API field names, not display labels.
Same SODA pattern works for all Socrata portals (data.cdc.gov, healthdata.gov, many cities).

compliance.redistributionNotes: Public domain US government data. Socrata app token ToS applies to the platform, not the data.
